_doc: Labeled ground truth for the enclosed-cove (όρμος) classifier. Every entry was verified by map/photo inspection, pilot-guide or beach-guide sourcing, or firsthand report — not by re-running the model. `expect` is what isEnclosedCoveGeometry MUST return. `via` records WHY the answer is what it is, so a future change can tell 'geometry got it right' apart from 'curation forced it'. Run: node scripts/validation/validate-cove-classifier.mjs

_open_issues.name: Πάνορμος (Νάξος)
_open_issues.issue: Very likely a real όρμος (operator report) but UNLABELLED on purpose: its authored windProfile sets suspectPin because the app pin sits in a SW-opening harbour notch while the real bay opens SE. The computed geometry describes the wrong water, so neither answer can be asserted. ACTION: fix the pin coordinate, then re-check — do not curate around the position caution.

_open_issues.name: Ερωτοσπηλιά
_open_issues.issue: Removed from positives 2026-07-25: was asserted without verification and genuinely fails the gate (nearLandRun 4, mouth 4). Re-add only with map/photo evidence.

positives.name: Βοϊδοκοιλιά
positives.why: Textbook near-circular όρμος, single narrow mouth. Calibration anchor since 2026-07-18.

positives.name: Άγιος Ερμογένης
positives.why: Horseshoe cove at the Gera gulf mouth; the case that motivated the whole enclosure model.

positives.name: Πόρτο Λιμνιώνας
positives.why: Narrow rock-armed inlet; classic Zakynthos cove.

positives.name: Porto Koufo
positives.why: Deepest natural harbour in Greece — a genuine near-closed όρμος. Fishing port, but the shelter is real and natural.

positives.name: Παλιόνησος
positives.why: Fjord-like inlet, max fetch 2 km in ANY direction; sub-sector morphology the 8 rays cannot see.

positives.name: Γερολιμνιώνας
positives.why: Near-closed horseshoe, land <=0.1 km in 6/8 sectors.

positives.name: Κάρβουνο
positives.why: Bay screened by the Μουρτεμένο/Άγ.Νικόλαος islets acting as a natural breakwater (visit-thesprotia, allovergreece).

positives.name: Αθερινός
positives.why: Fjord-like inlet, 'sheltered from most winds' in cruising guides; municipal quay only, not a marina.

positives.name: Μεγάλο Αμόνι
positives.why: Small E-facing «κολπίσκος», water reported always calm (travelstyle, sfedona).

positives.name: Κάτω Κάμπος
positives.why: 'Deep and narrow cove' with only a small pier (go-amorgos, Greeka).

positives.name: Μπλεφούτης
positives.why: Near-landlocked north bay guarded by the Στρογγυλή/Τρυπητή islets across the mouth.

positives.name: Άγιος Νικόλαος (Σύμη)
positives.why: Small sheltered pocket bay ringed by rocky hills, boat/foot access only.

positives.name: Πόρτο Κάγιο
positives.why: Near-circular historic natural harbour, 'lake-like waters' (Wikipedia, Navily).

positives.name: Βαθή (Σίφνος)
positives.why: 'One of the most sheltered bays in the Cyclades', safe anchorage even in full meltemi.

positives.name: Μέγα Λιβάδι
positives.why: Deep SW bay 'well sheltered from summer winds'; ore bridge is a defunct 1900s relic, not a port.

positives.name: Βάρη (Σύρος)
positives.why: Deep south bay, 'one of the most protected' swim spots of the island.

positives.name: Πόρτο Βρώμη
positives.why: Twin fjord inlets, ~100 m mouth; only the Ναυάγιο excursion jetty.

positives.name: Βαθύ (Αστερούσια)
positives.why: Gorge-mouth cove between long cliffs, 'protected from all winds except SW'.

positives.name: Ελίντα
positives.why: Narrow W/SW-mouth cove ringed by pine hills; hid the submarine «Παπανικολής» in WWII.

positives.name: Τσίλια
positives.why: Tiny boat-access-only cove, ~100-200 m mouth, at the Gera gulf approaches.

positives.name: Τρεις Κλεισιές βόρειος
positives.why: The island's ancient port — 'well protected from the winds', path access only.

positives.name: Άγιος Στέφανος (Κύθνος)
positives.why: Family cove sheltered from the etesians; yachts overnight in the bay.

positives.name: Τσαγκάρι
positives.why: Near-land 7/8 with single-sector mouth on the deeply indented, anchorage-grade south coast.

positives.name: Λεντού
positives.why: Shallow family cove screened by the Λέντου islet, 'well protected from the meltemia'.

positives.name: Γιάννακης
positives.why: Islet-screened pocket on the indented Galaxidi shore inside the sheltered Krissaios gulf.

positives.name: Λυχνάρι
positives.why: Natural «λιμανάκι» on the deeply indented Sofiko coast.

positives.name: Μικρό Αμόνι
positives.why: «Κολπίσκος» with calm water, twin of Μεγάλο Αμόνι.

negatives.name: Μουτσούνα
negatives.why: THE regression case (caught by Miltos 2026-07-25): passed the v2 gate on sector COUNT but all 3 mouth sectors carry 12-24 km fetch = a 135 deg open-water window. A bight, not an όρμος.

negatives.name: Λιγαρίδια
negatives.why: Open neighbour of Μουτσούνα on the same coast; must stay red when Μουτσούνα is red.

negatives.name: Άναξος
negatives.why: Open N-facing shore with 12.6 km fetch on the N sector. Long-standing labeled negative.

negatives.name: Μικρή Βίγλα
negatives.why: Kite/windsurf cape — a venturi, the opposite of shelter. Both sides of the cape must stay negative.

negatives.name: Μικρή Βίγλα (νότια)
negatives.why: South side of the same kite cape.

negatives.name: Φτελιά
negatives.why: Mykonos windsurf beach.

negatives.name: Αμμούδι
negatives.why: Cove-shaped but 'highly popular among windsurfing enthusiasts' (Greeka, cretanbeaches) — real wind exposure.

negatives.name: Αγριολίβαδο
negatives.why: Broad bay with 'strong gusts', an 'ideal destination for windsurf' (patmos-island, Greeka).

negatives.name: Πέδι
negatives.why: Morphologically a deep narrow bay BUT a working harbour with fishing fleet and 'Marina Symi' berths.

negatives.name: Σπηλιά
negatives.why: Porto Spilia is the MAIN car-ferry port of Meganisi.

negatives.name: Αντίσαμος
negatives.why: 'Large bay on the east side... faces east' — wide open E bay despite tourist 'protected' copy.

negatives.name: Παραλία Λίνδου
negatives.why: Wide-mouthed resort bay open NE/E below the acropolis.

negatives.name: Πόλη
negatives.why: Sits in the open Gulf of Polis facing W/NW, with a small fishing harbour.

negatives.name: Βιβάρι
negatives.why: Bay is a 'large natural harbor' opening SW to the Argolic Gulf; the enclosed lagoon behind is a SEPARATE water body.

negatives.name: Φύκιο
negatives.why: naxos.gr: 'tends to get windy as it's exposed to a northern wind' — directly contradicts calm-at-meltemi.

negatives.name: Αγιοφύλλι
negatives.why: Was curated until 2026-07-25. Verified an OPEN S-facing pocket with 'no natural protection from bigger waves' (amazinglefkada); mouth 5 sectors, fetch 14.8 km.

negatives.name: Πλαζ Καλαμπάκα
negatives.why: Urban rock/mole pocket at the Piraeus harbour mouth beside the Naval School.

negatives.name: Κούμ Καπί
negatives.why: Straight, fully open N-facing Chania city shore; the 'arms' are alongshore ray artefacts.

negatives.name: Χρυσή Αμμουδιά
negatives.why: 3 km sweep of one huge E-facing bay AND an established windsurf/kite spot.

negatives.name: Καραβοστάσι
negatives.why: Relatively long open north-coast beach, no topographic shelter.

negatives.name: Αλυκή (Πάρος)
negatives.why: Open village bay with fishing-harbour mole; meltemi-lee comfort, not cove morphology.

negatives.name: Πετάνι
negatives.why: Famous WIDE open W-facing Kefalonia bay; killed by the mouth-openness veto. If this ever reads cove, the veto has regressed.

negatives.name: Star Beach
negatives.why: Open N Crete resort shore, 25 km fetch.

negatives.name: Μαγγανάρι
negatives.why: Wide open S Ios bay.

negatives.name: Ελιά
negatives.why: Open S Mykonos beach.

negatives.name: Παραλία Βάρκιζας
negatives.why: Measured 2026-07-18 to be feature-identical to a real cove — the reason the strict core exists. Must never read cove.
